description_en: Queries the parameter settings of a host in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute接口查询专属集群某个主机的参数信息
kebab_example: aliyun cddc describe-dedicated-host-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-34639v1jt4y40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the Hosts page to view the host ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在主机列表查看并获取主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster in which the host is created. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the Dedicated Clusters page to view the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机所属集群的ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在集群列表查看并获取专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

AccountName.description_en:
The account name of the host.

The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
The name must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length
AccountName.description_zh:
主机账号名称。

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。

包含2~16个字符

AccountType.description_en:
The account type of the host. Valid values:

Normal: standard account.
Admin: administrator account
AccountType.description_zh:
账号类型，取值：

Normal：普通权限账号
Admin：管理员账号

AllocationStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether instances can be deployed on the host. Valid values:

Allocatable: yes.
Suspended: no
AllocationStatus.description_zh:
主机是否可分配实例，取值：

Allocatable：允许分配实例
Suspended：停止分配实例

AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled on the host. Valid values:

true
false (default)
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否开启自动续费功能，取值：
true：开启
false（默认值）：不开启

CPUAllocationRatio.description_en: The CPU overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster. Unit: %. The value is accurate to the tens digit
CPUAllocationRatio.description_zh: 专属集群的cpu超配比，单位为百分比，精确到10%

CpuUsed.description_en: The number of CPU cores used by the host

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the host was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 主机创建成功的时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

DedicatedHostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster in which the host is created

DiskAllocationRatio.description_en: The storage overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster
DiskAllocationRatio.description_zh: 专属集群的空间超配比

DistributionTag.description_en: The distribution tag of the host

EcsClassCode.description_en: The instance type of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the host. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 主机到期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

HostCPU.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the host

HostClass.description_en: The instance type of the host

HostMem.description_en: The memory size of the host. Unit: MB

HostStatus.description_en:
The state of the host. Valid values:

0: The host is being created.
1: The host is running.
2: The host is faulty.
3: The host is ready for disabling.
4: The host is being maintained.
5: The host is disabled.
6: The host is restarting.
7: The host is locked.

When a host fails, the host is disabled. Before the host is disabled, the data of the instances that run on the host is migrated to another host. This ensures data integrity
HostStatus.description_zh:
主机状态，取值：

0：创建中
1：运行中
2：故障中
3：准备下线
4：维护中
5：已下线
6：重启中
7：锁定中

当主机出现故障时，主机要下线，主机下线之前会将该故障主机上的实例进行迁移，从而保证数据的完整性

HostStorage.description_en: The total storage of the host. Unit: GB
HostStorage.description_zh: 主机的存储总量，单位为GB

HostType.description_en:
The storage type of the host. Valid values:

dhg_cloud_ssd or dhg_cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD).
dhg_local_ssd: local SSD
HostType.description_zh:
主机的存储类型，取值：


dhg_cloud_ssd、dhg_cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

dhg_local_ssd：本地SSD盘

IPAddress.description_en: The IP address of the host

ImageCategory.description_en:
The image of the host. This parameter is returned only when the database engine is SQL Server. Valid values:

WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense: SQL Server Cluster Edition (AlwaysOn).
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: SQL Server Standard Edition.
WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense: SQL Server Enterprise Edition.
WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense: SQL Server Web Edition
ImageCategory.description_zh:
主机镜像。引擎类型为SQL Server时返回，取值：

WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense：SQL Server集群版

WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：SQL Server标准版

WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense：SQL Server企业版

WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense：SQL Server Web版

InstanceNumber.description_en: The number of instances deployed on the host
InstanceNumber.description_zh: 主机上部署实例的个数

InstanceNumberMaster.description_en: The number of primary instances deployed on the host

InstanceNumberROMaster.description_en: The number of primary instances of the read-only instance deployed on the host
InstanceNumberROMaster.description_zh: 主机上只读实例的主节点数

InstanceNumberROSlave.description_en: The number of secondary instances of the read-only instance deployed on the host
InstanceNumberROSlave.description_zh: 主机上只读实例的备节点数

InstanceNumberSlave.description_en: The number of secondary instances deployed on the host

MemAllocationRatio.description_en: The memory usage of the host. Unit: %
MemAllocationRatio.description_zh: 内存使用率，单位为百分比

MemoryUsed.description_en: The amount of memory used by the host. Unit: GB
MemoryUsed.description_zh: 主机内存使用量，单位为GB

OpenPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the host OS permissions are grated. Valid values:

0: no.
1: yes
OpenPermission.description_zh:
是否开放专属集群内的主机的OS权限，取值：

0：不可开放状态
1：开放状态

StorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the host. Unit: GB
StorageUsed.description_zh: 主机的存储使用量，单位为GB
